scope: Read-only installed-backend review and tiny synthetic CUDA engineering fixtures, excluded from PermWorld source experiments.

primary_sources.finding: cuDNN RNN dropout state is a lazily initialized Tensor buffer in a static per-device C++ cache. Standard nn.GRU state_dict does not contain this buffer.

CUDA generator serialization contains seed and Philox offset. Restoring state invokes set_current_seed, which resets the RNN-state flag. The subsequent dropout-enabled cuDNN call reinitializes its buffer.

The private initializer returns the dropout-state Tensor, and private _cudnn_rnn accepts an explicit dropout-state Tensor. Such a user-owned Tensor is serializable, but standard nn.GRU offers no supported public exporter/importer for its C++ cached buffer.

interpretation: Native fixture confirms the current ordinary-checkpoint path fails exact fresh-process CUDA continuation. Source inspection identifies uncheckpointed cuDNN dropout state as a concrete mechanism. This is an engineering finding, not a PermWorld scientific result or a claim about all RNN implementations.

fallback.implementation: Four single-layer GRUs with internal dropout0, explicit torch.nn.Dropout(.1) between first three recurrent layers; preserve embedding dropout, final normalization, tied output head.
fallback.initialization: Value-preserving mapping from the actually saved native step0; not seed-only regeneration. Record original file/parameter hashes, mapping, per-tensor equality, new checkpoint/hash, vocabulary/model configuration and RNG provenance. Parameter names differ, so name-sensitive parameter hash differs even if corresponding tensors are equal.
fallback.validation: Tiny CPU eval logits/gradients and CPU replay exact. Tiny CUDA initial-tensor equality and parameter count preserved; eval logits error3.5762786865234375e-7. Fresh-process explicit-dropout CUDA replay has exact parameters, optimizer, RNG and loss.
fallback.limits: The stochastic backend changes; keep failed native evidence, version and refreeze before source training. Tiny fixture does not replace fixed1000-update overfit or genuine2000-update source-data resume gate. Do not merge source results across backend versions or relax tolerances.
